newsitem.title: USA: Tech rally ups Nasdaq to second largest point gain.
newsitem.headline: Tech rally ups Nasdaq to second largest point gain.

text.p: A massive rally in technology stocks pushed the Nasdaq Composite Index up 30 points -- the second largest one-day point gain ever.
The Nasdaq Composite Index gained 30 points, or 2.34 percent, to close at 1310, its third highest composite close.

The 30-point jump was also the second largest one-day point increase, falling short of a record set on July 17, 1996. On that day, the Nasdaq surged 33.18 points to close at 1086.65, Nasdaq officials said.
Bullish comments on Intel Corp by a Salomon Brothers analyst triggered a broad technology buying spree.
The enthusiasm continued after Merrill Lynch restated its forecast for a quick recovery for the U.S. semiconductor industry in 1997.
Intel soared eight to 138-3/8. Dell Computer Corp jumped 4-5/8 to 55-7/8. Microsoft Corp gained three to 84-5/8. Oracle Corp swelled to 44-5/8, up 2-5/8.
"Intel was the biggest winner, but the whole technology sector had a big day," one trader said.
The Dow also stormed higher, gained 101.60 points to close unofficially at 6544.09. The long-bond gained 1/32 to yield 6.74 percent.
